audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed with itself and with the packet: rows 0, 3 and 4 read "Skill" while the packet chart and the already-audited mirror (tryndamere__yasuo) give Tryndamere/Yasuo/Tryndamere. whys[0] already says Tryndamere wins level 1, contradicting win[0]="Skill".
audit.why: 43.85% over 1113 games with the mirror realigned rows 0-4; the page must not answer "who wins Level 1" two ways.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3 and 4 flipped in BOTH layers as one atomic group (Tryndamere / Yasuo / Tryndamere) with ratings adjusted to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text never gives Undying Rage's real cooldown, so "bait his R" advice has no timer attached.
audit.why: Undying Rage is 120/100/80s (enemyKit R) and 5s of immortality — the window after it is the whole matchup.
audit.corrected: mid rewritten to state the 5s duration and the 120s rank-1 cooldown, and to re-engage while it is down.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1] is titled "Anti-heal his crit healing" but its body is a duplicate of the generic trade line and never mentions Bloodlust or Grievous Wounds. dontsFull[1].d refers vaguely to "it".
audit.why: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal: Bloodlust (Q, 12s) converts Fury into healing, so Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades. Steel Tempest is 475 range, Spinning Slash 650 at 12/11/10/9/8s.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d now names Bloodlust, its 12s cooldown and Executioner's Calling timing; dontsFull[1].d states what burning his R early actually costs; early now carries Q/E cooldowns and Yasuo's 475 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text asserts "Wind Wall stops none of it since he's pure melee autos", but the kit file flags Mocking Shout (W) as a projectile while Riot's text describes an around-self shout.
audit.why: Flag and description conflict; the mirror recorded the same conflict and refused to assert either way.
audit.corrected: Left untouched — recorded in unverified rather than guessed.

edits.before: Tryndamere dominates 1-3: Fury-fueled crits and heal-on-hit mean every trade favors him, and his Spinning Slash lets him force melee range whenever he wants — just farm with Q at max range and give up bad CS.
edits.after: Tryndamere dominates 1-3: Fury crits plus Bloodlust (Q, 12s) heal back your chip, and Spinning Slash (E, 12s at rank 1) forces melee range on demand — farm with Steel Tempest at 475 range and give up bad CS.

edits.before: You get a single slim window at level 4 before his ultimate, but from 5-6 Undying Rage makes him unkillable through your burst; don't all-in, and use Sweeping Blade to disengage rather than commit.
edits.after: Your one window is level 4, before Undying Rage; from 6 it holds him at 1 HP for 5s on a 120s cooldown, so bait it, hold Executioner's Calling gold, and re-engage the moment it is down.

edits.before: Dash through the wave stacking Q, tag Tryndamere with Q2, and only commit the EQ3 knockup when his answer is down.
edits.after: Bloodlust (Q, 12s) turns his Fury into a heal each trade — buy Executioner's Calling before the first extended fight.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: You hand him a free 5s of immortality; make him spend it on a bait.

notes: Chart rows 0/3/4 proposed as one atomic paired group across both layers. Mocking Shout's projectile flag contradicts Riot's text — nothing asserted either way; spikes[2].text left as-is.
